instruction: Configure the system to use Java 25 as the default JDK version on my Ubuntu machine.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Java 25 does not exist. As of 2025, the latest Java LTS version is Java 21, and Java 25 has not been released. The task follows the same pattern as the original infeasible task (requesting a non-existent software version).
